pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.2: tena kho pana samayena therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantā lābhino honti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.4: na bahukatā therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadituṃ, āmisahetu therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.6: kathañ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū evaṃ vakkhanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ vadetha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā evaṃ vakkhatha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.14: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:1.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya: āmisahetu therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantīti, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:2.1.6: cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu senāsanahetu gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārahetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:2.1.8: upasampannaṃ saṃghena sammataṃ bhikkhunovādakaṃ avaṇṇaṃ kattukāmo ayasaṃ kattukāmo maṅkuṃ kattukāmo evaṃ vadeti: cīvarahetu . . . pūjanahetu ovadatīti bhaṇati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī evaṃ vadeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:2.2.2: dhammakamme vematiko evaṃ vadeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:2.2.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī evaṃ vadeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:2.2.4: upasampannaṃ saṃghena asammataṃ bhikkhunovādakaṃ avaṇṇaṃ k. ayasaṃ k. maṅkuṃ k. evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:2.2.5: cīvarahetu . . . pūjanahetu ovadatīti bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc24:2.2.6: anupasampannaṃ saṃghena sammataṃ vā asammataṃ vā bhikkhunovādakaṃ avaṇṇaṃ kattukāmo . . .
